The default-off Opportunities stream projects the caller-owned, already tenant-scoped bounded quote read into identity and four separate proposal, commercial, customer, and operational momentum domains; only proposal completeness may use a percentage. It keeps quote lifecycle, booking confirmation, deposit, and final balance independent, chooses one recommended next step, preserves local-fallback truth and the legacy controls under Quote administration, and hands the exact opaque opportunity plus its arrival context to the canonical Living Opportunity. The administrator-only Library projects the existing organization-scoped catalog snapshot into Catalog and first-class Event Templates, presents source, observation, Catalog version, pricing-review, and incomplete-menu boundaries in calm task-centered language, shows contextual recovery for unavailable exact arrivals, retains dirty drafts across ordinary workspace navigation, keeps catalog-setting and managed-menu draft domains from advancing together, prevents fresher evidence from silently replacing work, and opens exact objects only through the existing guarded editor and save authority. Its development fallback cache and revision comparison are organization-scoped and remain explicitly non-authoritative. A portal-token provider remount occurs only after the App-level draft guard accepts the transition; direct initial portal precedence remains intact and each distinct token receives a distinct public scope. The default-off Ambient NOW briefing narrows the existing bounded staff snapshot to at most three already-ranked Workflow priorities, withholds caught-up language whenever reads or bounds are incomplete, and shows only timestamp-backed internal workflow receipts as quiet progress. The default-off staff shell's global Pilot trigger resolves only the exact context already in view: it relays a matching Living Opportunity into its populated evidence explanation, focuses the existing deterministic draft command field without executing it when that independent gate is enabled, or presents a nonempty choose-an-opportunity recovery instead of generic chat. In Ambient mode, supported browser speech uses pointer or keyboard hold-to-capture, immediate contextual state, release-to-preview, bounded transcript handling, and exact recovery; the transcript is not persisted or staged, explicit Apply remains required, and the flag-off Pilot retains its existing click-to-toggle behavior. Exact arrivals carry only allowlisted semantics and opaque identifiers and remain pending until a supported destination proves exact focus without substitution. Schedule supports only exact accepted/booked events and complete-current-conflict evidence while refusing to conflate its legacy staff-lead field with authoritative operational staffing. Reporting supports only exact opportunity, bounded pipeline, and Ambient interaction-health targets and keeps its targeted opportunity read outside aggregate denominators. Selection scenarios remain local, reversible, unpriced, and unsaved; Money preserves five payment evidence domains; Proposal separates saved revision, authoritative pricing, customer projection, portal issuance, and provider acceptance; Conversation keeps sent, provider-delivered, portal-viewed, replied, and inferred engagement independent; higher-authority Pilot classes remain blocked. The separately gated customer decision room composes the existing exact-token projection into calm Event, Menu and service, Pricing, Planning assumptions, Terms, Possible additions, Response, and Questions sections. Staff-marked additions stage only reversible ordinary change-request lines, and contextual questions reuse one existing conversation composer with explicit staged, preserved-draft, pending-attempt, read-only, and unavailable acknowledgements.
